component.name: Wing Commander II (Experimental)
component.summary: Experimental SDL2 port of Wing Commander II

description.p: Play Wing Commander II: Vengeance of the Kilrathi and its Special Operations 1 and 2 expansions using your own original game files. Supports Kilrathi Saga and DOS data.
This Flatpak is experimental and has not been validated on Steam Deck. Please report installation, controls, saving and suspend/resume results.
Original game files are not included.
